title: Listening Drill — Coast litter survey
description: Fieldwork briefing. One recording, four questions. Synthetic audio.

sections.title: Coast litter survey
sections.transcript:
LEADER: Let me explain how we'll collect data about litter on the beach. Each pair will have the same instructions. That matters because another group needs to be able to repeat what you've done.

LEADER: Start with the marked strip. Record the first reading at eight. The quantity we're comparing is item count. Use the tally counter marked with blue tape.

LEADER: At the end, separate natural material from litter. If you miss a reading, mark it as missing. Don't fill in a number by copying the nearest result.
